description: This file defines the KeyboardTheme class, which extends AddOnImpl, representing a theme configuration for a keyboard in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It manages various style resource IDs related to keyboard themes, popup themes, icons, and gesture trails, providing accessor methods for these properties.

classes.name: KeyboardTheme
classes.description: A class representing a keyboard theme with various style resource IDs, extending AddOnImpl.
